main: ^He breathes laboriously, trying to scramble away from you.
^He’s clutching the wound on his shoulder defensively.
choice1: ^The man looks like he needs a drink and something to bandage his wound with.
choice2: ^The man gazes at you weakly, but he says nothing more. His breath is getting more and more laborious by the second, but you get up and leave.
assistHideo: ^You drop a cloth and some water in front of the injured man.
^You take his injured shoulder, and he lets you, and with your little hands although inexperienced, you wrap it in the makeshift bandage to soak up the blood.
^Then, you help him take gentle sips of water.
^His mouth then moves, but you don’t quite understand what he said.
^It seems he’s speaking Japanese, which is a language you don't quite understand fluently.
^You nod anyway and get up to leave, but before you can leave, he takes your wrist and quickly places something in your hand.
^It seems like a dogtag that many military men wear, engraved with his initials.
^You thank him in your language before heading on your way.
talkedToHideo: ^The man doesn't have much to say. He doesn't look like he has the energy to, if he had anything to say anyway.
